headline: Direxion unveils options income ETF suite tied to Nvidia, Tesla and other megacap
summary: Investing.com -- Direxion on Wednesday launched a new family of exchange-traded funds designed to generate income by writing call options on individual high-volatility stocks, expanding beyond its traditional leveraged and inverse ETF offerings.
